Summary: Expedition 23: Our Journey Continues Reward Ship.
Description:
An exclusive golden edition of the classic Rasamama S36, commemorating completion of the expedition Our Journey Continues, and the pilgrimage through past iterations of No Man's Sky.

This highly-manoeuvrable spacecraft is constructed from a durable and precious alloy, and coated in a tough layer of fibrous insulation to endure many lifetimes' worth of rigorous space exploration.
